# Architecture

- **[HAR-SSOT-001] MUST — One owner per fact.** Give every product fact (URL, identifier, limit, version, user-facing string, style value) one owning module or repository; everything else imports it, generates it, or vendors it with recorded provenance, and a copy that cannot be generated has a check that fails when it differs. (gated)
- **[HAR-ARCH-002] MUST — Cohesive files.** Keep one concept per file; split a file when it holds more than one concept, not when it passes a line count. (gated)
- **[HAR-ARCH-003] MUST — Layered models.** Keep protocol, domain, persistence, and view models separate; validate and convert data where it crosses a layer, and share no mutable state across layers. (gated)
- **[HAR-ARCH-004] MUST — Failure-aware backends.** Design backend work for idempotency, races, transaction boundaries, timeouts, cancellation, bounded retries, backpressure, and resource release; never hide a fault behind an unbounded retry, a swallowed error, or implicit shared state. (gated)
- **[HAR-ARCH-005] MUST — No stale paths.** When restructuring an internal path, delete the old implementation instead of adding a compatibility layer, deprecated shim, or dual write; judge compatibility only for external contracts such as public APIs and database migrations. Every workaround or `TODO` states its reason, impact, and removal condition and links a tracked issue. (gated)
